_doc: Schema reference. This entry is filtered out by backend/utils/dataLoader.js and is not exposed to any consumer. JSON has no native comments, so this object serves as in-file documentation.

_standardFields.name: string - display name; matching is case-insensitive and accent-normalised
_standardFields.iata: string - 2-char IATA code, or 'NA' when the airline has none
_standardFields.icao: string - 3-char ICAO callsign, or 'NA' when the airline has none
_standardFields.country: string - country of registration (used to derive jurisdiction limits)

_specialFields.reqs: string - claim-document requirements shown in the Document Check tool and the Ticket Analyzer's 'Mandatory claim documents' section. Omit the field entirely when the airline needs no extra docs; the helper falls back to 'No documents required'.
_specialFields.ticketPrefix: string - 3-digit airline ticket number prefix shown in the Document Check tool and the Ticket Analyzer claim-document labels. Omit when unknown.
_specialFields.ticketNumberCanReplacePnr: boolean (default false) - when true, a passenger's ticket number alone satisfies identification; the Document Check page and Ticket Analyzer FlightCard render a 'Ticket # replaces PNR' chip.
_specialFields.claimNote: string - free-form note shown next to the reqs body, e.g. 'PNR mandatory', 'Ticket number mandatory', 'Either PNR or ticket number'. Rendered as a separate paragraph beneath reqs in both tools.
_specialFields.oneTimeSubmission: boolean (default false) - when true, the Document Check page and Ticket Analyzer FlightCard render a 'One-time submission' label for airlines where a passenger-submitted claim allows a parallel request.
_specialFields.trackerSearchCodes: object { airportInfo?: string, flightStats?: string, flightera?: string } - per-tracker replacement code used when the airline's IATA doesn't resolve on an external tracker (e.g. { 'flightStats': 'PU*' } for Plus Ultra, or { 'airportInfo': 'EVE', 'flightStats': 'EVE', 'flightera': 'EVE' } for Iberojet). Trackers not listed fall back to the parsed IATA. Surfaced via GET /api/tools/tracker-overrides and consumed by client/src/pages/TicketAnalyzer/ticketAnalyzerUtils.js::buildTrackerURLs.
_specialFields.ceasedOperations: boolean (default false) - when true, the Document Check page and Ticket Analyzer FlightCard render a 'Ceased operations' label for airlines that no longer operate.
